reviewer.tools: read-only; no tester execution, no live store access

verdicts.no_invented_closure: PASS, changed from FAIL in the first review

what_the_review_confirmed_as_fixed: the closure target is now re-derived from the protected send ACK instead of the mutable run field
peer chat, sender, private type, bot flag, media absence, text type, message id, window bounds, existing observation and budgets are all checked
the first-review vector, recording an unrelated or foreign text as the answer, is gone

defects_fixed_in_v14.before: closure required a reply_to_message, while the normal path also accepts a nonce-correlated message without one; a legitimate refusal on such a message left the marker open forever and the next inventory refused every command
defects_fixed_in_v14.after: closure accepts either the ACK reply target or continuation_document_match, exactly like the normal path

defects_fixed_in_v14.before: a wire-envelope ACK was never unwrapped, so ack.message_id was null and closure was always refused
defects_fixed_in_v14.after: an envelope with ok true and a result object is unwrapped before the message id comparison

defects_fixed_in_v14.before: a message dated more than 30 s in the future was recorded, although the normal path refuses it
defects_fixed_in_v14.after: the same bounded date check is applied

defects_fixed_in_v14.before: closure used a strict less-than on the capture window, so the exact boundary differed from the normal path
defects_fixed_in_v14.after: the window bound matches the normal path; the arrival bound stays strict as in the normal path

defects_fixed_in_v14.before: a duplicate delivery of an already committed message id was refused by the gate, so the marker stayed open where the normal path closes without an observation
defects_fixed_in_v14.after: the message id check moved from eligibility to recordability: the marker closes with no observation instead of staying open

defects_fixed_in_v14.before: the continuation admission gate was not mirrored, so a reply that the normal path discards as non-contract could be recorded
defects_fixed_in_v14.after: the admitted-kind gate is mirrored; a non-contract reply is not recorded

defects_deliberately_not_changed.reason: the blanket handler that hides partial writes is fail-closed: the marker stays open or inventory reports an unpaired witness, never an invented closure
defects_deliberately_not_changed.note: the docstring no longer claims that every check reads durable bytes

defects_deliberately_not_changed.reason: committed_message_ids raising on a corrupt older receipt is correct custody behaviour; it aborts closure rather than inventing it
recordable is now always true when closure is reached; over-budget refusals stay open rather than closing with no observation, which is the conservative direction
defense-in-depth gaps that cannot produce a false closure; recorded and left for the post-B00 cleanup

verification.gate_result: 17 of 17 match the normal path on an isolated copy
cases: date equal to the window bound accepted (N6)
already committed message id eligible but not recordable (N5)

end_to_end.method: historical run replayed on an isolated copy, closure forced by a local refusal
end_to_end.inventory_after_closure: refused in the replay only because concurrent live runs had advanced the shared cursor beyond the replayed chain; the closure receipt itself uses the same offset as the intent receipt it closes

honest_limits: no live refusal has yet occurred under v14, so the inventory-after-closure path is proven by construction, not by an observed live refusal
N1 and N3 remain latent: neither was reachable in this environment during the review
